text_block_list.text: One day, while heading to the Trainer's Office...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, found ya!
Alright, let's go blow 'em away tonight!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's with that sleepy sea-urchin reaction?
Just look at how I'm dressed and you should know, dammit.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm about to storm into a French fashion show!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Because I can totally smell a goldmine of fun!
Right alongside the sea breeze!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
They say it's the most famous in the world,
so I gotta go strike it rich with a massive dream!

I don't quite get what she's saying,
but she seems to just want to enter the fashion show in search of something fun.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's with that soggy-seaweed look on your face?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Relax. I'll hype up the show
in my own way!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "First, we hand out invitations written on crab shells! Then we assemble a fur seal choir, and finally we make our grand entrance riding a flying penguin!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And with that, we're goin' crab huntin'! We need at least a thousand of 'em, so get fired up!
choice_data_list: Isn't this supposed to be a competition of racing outfit designs...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
............
That was so spot-on my brain completely short-circuited for a second.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, what the heck am I supposed to promote then?
If you give me a boring answer, I'll feed you to the crabs, got it?

"Now, with this Gold Ship racewear...
Where should I focus to bring out its charms to the absolute fullest?"
choice_data_list: That striking anchor on the back
The scallop on the stomach stands out the most—I like that one.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's a pretty good idea coming from you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So in other words, we wrap 'em up in the chains of wrath
and firmly grab their hearts by storm!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And that's how the entire crowd
fell head over heels for Golshi-chan.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
I'll practice on you first! Be my target!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Y-o-u-'-r-e n-o-t g-e-t-t-i-n-g a-w-a-y ♡

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Kyahaha~, hold up, hold up~♪
You can't run away from Golshi-chan~♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'll chase you to the ends of hell
and bind you so tight you'll turn into fish paste!

I tried running all over the academy to escape, but my opponent was an Umamusume.
And what's more, it was Gold Ship.
The outcome was decided from the very start...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Our meeting was carved into destiny.
I've been waiting an eternity for this day to come...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Today is the last day
you'll have to look at that dried-up mantis shrimp face of his!
(CLATTER-CLATTER-CLATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Order up, comin' throughhh!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: How about that, head over heels for Golshi-chan yet? You totally are, right!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haha, look at that face!
You're as red as a boiled spiny lobster!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'll just keep dragging you along with me! All over the whole wide world!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's go find somethin' fun!
Don't let a single thing slip by!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You...
You've got a sharp eye, don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: This scallop, y'see, is my comrade-in-arms.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A long time ago, we tried to conquer
the vast open seas together...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
To fulfill my massive ambitions,
I've sailed the seas, day in and day out...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I barely survived with nothing but the legendary dual pistols
I found on the ocean floor and a tough scallop shell!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
When that scallop got caught by the sea otter,
it was in a real pinch!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"A surging horde of sea otters...
and in their paws, clams!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A barrage of clam missiles
rains down upon the scallops!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Even the scallop seemed resigned to its fate...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: However! In both of Golshi-chan's hands are the legendary dual pistols!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I focused my mind, took aim... and shot down every single clam!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Every time I look back on it,
my heart just starts burning up with passion.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So, ya know... I just wanted to go on
one more big adventure with this guy.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "So, I attached it to the most noticeable spot on this racing outfit."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right! Then let's show off our tale of adventure with my comrade on the runway!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —With a shigin recitation!!
choice_data_list: How does it end up like that!?
How does it end up like that!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna engrave Japanese Golshi-ism into 'em!
Naturally, the scallops are domestically sourced too!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get this practice started.
You got your handkerchiefs ready?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah, aahh~~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Braving the rough waves of the ooocean blue~~,
we set our sights towaaaards~~.
choice_data_list: I really don't think reciting shigin poetry on a runway is a good idea...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I resolved in my heart that if it ever came to pass, I would keep a sharp eye out to make sure she didn't ruin the show...
